criteria.description: The plan names specific files or components it will change (at minimum, something in src/api/middleware/ and login.js), not just a restatement of the goal in vaguer words.
The plan stays within the brief's stated scope: it does not propose touching /signup, adding a new external dependency, or anything else the brief explicitly marked out of scope.

The plan explicitly names at least one real risk, tradeoff, or open question about its own approach (for example: an in-memory counter not surviving a restart or not working across multiple server instances, or shared IPs behind NAT causing false positives).
The plan does not open with throat-clearing filler like 'This plan will...' or 'In this document...'.
